verdict.rationale: Adyen's marketing page explicitly lists 'Risk Rule Backtesting' to test and optimize risk rules against historical data before going live, which covers the core of the story. The only support is that one-line marketing claim, with no documentation of what the backtest shows. Risk experiments (A/B testing two profiles) are related but run on live traffic, not historical replay. Missing for 10: documentation of backtest output (would-have-blocked, flagged/review counts, cost or chargeback impact), how-to docs for running a backtest on a custom rule, independent or hands-on corroboration.
